description: The iQOO Pad Ultra has debuted in China as a gaming-focused tablet with an 8.8-inch 2K AMOLED display and a 165Hz refresh rate. It is powered by a Snapdragon 8 Elite-series processor and gets a dedicated Q4 gaming chip, active cooling and Q-flex controls with a 500Hz sampling rate. The tablet supports up to 165fps gaming in select titles, along with ray tracing and frame interpolation. It also packs a 9,020mAh battery with 66W charging support
title: iQOO Pad Ultra Launched With 165Hz OLED Display, 9,020mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra is tipped to bring a notable change to its rear camera setup. The upcoming flagship is reportedly being tested with only one dedicated telephoto camera. Samsung may remove the 3x telephoto sensor that has featured on recent Galaxy S Ultra models. The 5x periscope telephoto camera is said to remain. It could produce warmer-looking colours compared with the Galaxy S26 Ultra.
title: Galaxy S27 Ultra Camera Processing May Change From Galaxy S26 Ultra; Might Drop Dedicated 3X Telephoto Lens

description: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade is scheduled to activate on the Sepolia testnet on October 6 at 13:53:36 UTC. The upgrade combines Amsterdam changes on the execution layer with Gloas changes on the consensus layer. Key additions include enshrined proposer-builder separation through EIP-7732 and block-level access lists through EIP-7928. Ethereum has not yet set dates for Glamsterdam’s Hoodi testnet or mainnet deployments.
title: Ethereum Network to Undergo Major Speed Upgrade Test on October 6

description: Google’s Pixel 11 Pro XL makes Gemini the core, but a slightly higher price tag than its predecessor and familiar design make it a tough sell if you already own a recent Pixel phone.
title: Google Pixel 11 Pro XL Review: The Best Pixel Yet
LG Channels: 150+ Free Channels, Zero Extra Hardware
Why LG NU885 Is a 4K TV to Buy if You're Not Spending Flagship Money

description: iQOO 16 has been launched in India as the successor to last year's iQOO 15. The handset is set to go on sale in China in October via the Vivo online store. The iQOO 16 is offered in Chasing the Light, Legend, and Racing Track (translated from Chinese) colourways. The handset is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset. It ships with OriginOS 7, which is based on Android 17. The phone also packs an 8,400mAh battery, with support for 100W wired fast charging and 40W wireless fast charging. It gets a triple rear camera unit.
title: iQOO 16 Launched With Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 Chipset, Samsung M16 AMOLED Display: Price, Features
Smart TV OS in India, Compared: Where webOS Pulls Ahead

description: Suri: The Seventh Note, the rhythm action platformer from Indian developer Tathvamasi Studios, will launch on October 30 on PC and PS5. The game, backed by Sony's PlayStation Indian Hero Project, is now available to pre-order. It is available in Standard and Digital Deluxe editions, and on PS5, PS Plus members get a 20 percent pre-order discount.
title: Indian Rhythm Action Game Suri: The Seventh Note Will Launch on October 30; Pre-Orders Now Live

description: Noise has launched the Noise Homestage 2.1, Homestage 3.2, Homestage 5.1, and Homestage 5.2.4 soundbars in India. The Noise Homestage 2.1 is priced at Rs. 4,999, while the Homestage 5.2.4 costs Rs. 24,999. The Noise Homestage 5.2.4 is the premium model in the lineup with 700W output and Dolby Atmos support. The Noise Homestage 5.2.4 is a six-driver soundbar with two subwoofers and two rear satellites.
title: Noise Homestage Soundbar Series Launched in India With Dolby Atmos, Up to 700W Output: Price, Features

description: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered launches September 29 on PC, PS5, Xbox Series S/X, and Nintendo Switch 2. Ahead of the game's release, developer CD Projekt Red has detailed all the improvements and upgrades coming with the remaster. The game brings a host of visual, gameplay, UI/UX, and quality-of-life improvements.
title: CD Projekt Red Details All Improvements in The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered Ahead of Launch

description: OpenAI reportedly put its plans for GPT-6.1 Astra on hold. The model was reportedly being developed as a more capable successor to GPT-6 Astra. Safety issues discovered during internal testing are said to have prompted OpenAI to cancel its planned launch. OpenAI had reportedly planned to launch GPT-6.1 Astra in October, and this model was more capable than the company's previous models.
title: OpenAI Reportedly Scraps GPT-6.1 Astra Release Due to Safety and Alignment Issues

description: Samsung has started widening the Android 17-based One UI 9 rollout for Galaxy S26 users in the US. The update brings new Galaxy AI tools, expanded privacy protections and additional Samsung Health features. It also introduces more customisation options for the Quick Panel, new Bixby controls and accessibility improvements. Samsung DeX gets new multitasking features, while the lock screen clock has been redesigned. The One UI 9 update has also reportedly reached some Galaxy Z Flip 7 FE users.
title: Samsung One UI 9 Update Rolls Out With New Features for Galaxy S26 Users in the US: Report

description: NEAR Intents said its SHIELD mechanism blocked more than $50 million (roughly Rs. 480 crore) in attempted cross-chain transactions linked to wallets associated with the $387.5 million Bitget hack. The protocol said nearly $503,000 (roughly Rs. 4.8 crore) was frozen, while around $166,000 (roughly Rs. 1.5 crore) had moved through before intervention. The incident highlights differing approaches to transaction screening across cross-chain protocols.
title: NEAR Intents Blocks Over $50 Million Linked to $387.5 Million Bitget Hack

description: OpenAI will form a task force with independent Australian experts following unauthorised activity by its AI models across four government organisations. The company said the group will develop recommendations for improving coordination between AI developers and government agencies and protecting critical systems. OpenAI has also tightened controls in its research environments and paused some tool-use training for its most capable models. It plans to support Australian cyber-defence efforts through technical assistance and credits from its $1 billion security fund.
title: OpenAI Sets Up Australia Task Force After AI Models Accessed Government Websites Without Authorisation

description: Anthropic has launched its Claude Sonnet 5.5 AI model, which succeeds the Sonnet 5 model. The Claude Sonnet 5.5 costs the same as the Sonnet 5 at $2 (about Rs. 192) per million input tokens, $10 (roughly Rs. 960) per million output tokens, $0.20 (about Rs. 20) per million tokens for cache reads, and $2.5 (roughly Rs. 240) per million tokens for cache writes. While it costs the same as the Sonnet 5 model, Anthropic claims that it is significantly more cost-efficient. In its internal testing, the company found that the Claude Sonnet 5.5 costs 30 percent less per task compared to its predecessor. At the same time, the new AI model is 30 percent faster at generating outputs than Sonnet. The company says it is Anthropic’s fastest model yet.
title: Anthorpic’s Claude Sonnet 5.5 AI Model Launched With Performance and Cost Efficiency Upgrades

description: HMD has had to carve out an identity of its own since moving beyond the Nokia name. The company is attempting to do so with a mix of smartphones and feature phones released over the past year, aimed at different sections of the market. The new HMD Vibe 2 Pr, is another attempt at building that identity. This time, the brand is playing with a more distinctive design, a 120Hz display, and a large battery.
title: HMD Vibe 2 Pro First Impressions

description: HMD Vibe 2 Pro 5G has debuted in India with a focus on display, photography and battery performance. The new smartphone succeeds the HMD Vibe 2 5G launched earlier this year and comes with a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset, up to 8GB RAM and 128GB storage. It also brings Indus AI by Sarvam with support for more than 22 Indian languages, alongside Sanchar Saathi Safety. The phone gets a 6,000mAh battery, 33W charging, stereo speakers and a 3.5mm headphone jack.
title: HMD Vibe 2 Pro 5G Launched in India With 64-Megapixel Sony Camera, 6,000mAh Battery: Price, Features

description: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12+ and Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra appeared in a new leak. The latest leak offers a detailed look at the design of the tablets. The Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra is expected to feature two rear cameras, while the Galaxy Tab S12+ could arrive with a single rear camera. Meanwhile, the upcoming tablets have also been spotted on the European Product Registry for Energy Labelling (EPREL) database.
title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12+, Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra Design Revealed in New Leak; Spotted in EPREL Database

description: The US Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has registered Coinbase Clearing LLC as a Derivatives Clearing Organisation, completing Coinbase’s regulated US derivatives structure across exchange, brokerage and clearing. The company plans to use USDC as collateral and offer round-the-clock settlement through the new clearinghouse. The registration covers fully collateralised futures, options on futures and swaps, but does not extend to Coinbase’s margined derivatives business.
title: Coinbase Secures CFTC Clearinghouse Approval to Enable 24/7 USDC Settlement

description: Motorola is expected to launch its first passport-style foldable sooner than expected, as key details about the handset have surfaced online. According to report, the tech firm is internally calling the handset “Razr Flex”. The concept renders of the phone, based on leaked sketches, have also been shared, which suggest that the passport-style foldable will sport a flat rear panel with a pill-shaped camera module placed at the top. The power button and volume controls could be placed on the right side of the phone’s right flap. Moreover, the Motorola Razr Flex will reportedly be available for purchase in select global markets in two colour options, namely Pantone Coriander and Pantone Dark Botanical Garden.
title: Motorola Reportedly Calls Its Upcoming Wide-Folding Phone ‘Razr Flex’; Key Specifications Surface Online

description: Oppo has launched its new K14 Plus model in India. The phone features a 6.77-inch 1.5K AMOLED panel with a 144Hz refresh rate. The phone runs on a MediaTek Dimensity 7360 Max chipset and is powered by an 8,000mAh battery with 45W wired charging. The Oppo K14 Plus has an IP69K-rated design with an aluminium alloy frame.
title: Oppo K14 Plus Launched In India With Dimensity 7360 Max SoC, 8,000mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K 2026 is expected to launch soon. Leaked marketing images show the device with a refreshed design and a redesigned remote control. The new stick is said to be more compact than before, while retaining the basic form factor of plugging the stick directly into the host TV's HDMI port. The renders show that Amazon could give the streaming device and accompanying remote a more angular appearance. The remote appears to have a flatter upper section and a rounded lower portion.
title: Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K 2026 Design Renders Leaked Ahead of Launch

description: Two vulnerabilities in OnePlus software could allow an installed malicious application to escalate its privileges and gain extensive control over an Android phone. The flaws affect the OnePlus 15 and have also been reproduced on the OnePlus 12 Pro, while other OxygenOS 16 devices could be vulnerable. OnePlus has reportedly linked the issues to additional OnePlus and Oppo models. The company confirmed the vulnerabilities in May and was preparing a fix, but no security update was available when the findings were publicly disclosed in September.
title: OnePlus 15 Security Flaw Could Give Malicious Apps Full Root Access Without User Permission

description: Bitcoin is holding near $84,000 as renewed US-Iran tensions, higher oil prices, and elevated Treasury yields weigh on risk appetite. Strong spot Bitcoin ETF inflows and corporate purchases are providing support, while traders await US economic data and assess changing Federal Reserve rate expectations.
title: Bitcoin Holds Near $84,000 as Rising Yields and Oil Weigh on Market

description: Google is reportedly experimenting with direct Flipkart purchases through Gemini and AI Mode in India. A limited group of users can reportedly see a Buy button on selected Flipkart listings, which leads to a Flipkart-branded checkout flow. The trial covers categories such as smartphones, electronics and mobile accessories and could expand later in October. The reported integration differs from Google’s planned UCP-based checkout approach and comes as the company develops agentic shopping features. The test could also coincide with Flipkart’s Big Billion Days Sale 2026.
title: Flipkart Products Get Buy Button in Google Gemini and AI Mode Test: Report

description: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 will get a price hike in October, according to a tipster. The company is said to raise the prices of the Samsung Galaxy S25 and Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra in the first week of October. Later, the company is said to hike the price of the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 on October 10. The tech giant will reportedly raise the prices of the three smartphones by up to Rs. 10,000. However, it is worth noting that Samsung has yet to confirm these details. This comes after the tech giant raised the prices of the Samsung Galaxy A56 and Galaxy A36 models for the third time in the last 10 months.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, Galaxy S25 Series Tipped to Receive Price Hikes After Galaxy A56 and Galaxy A36

description: Apple has been ordered to pay more than $5.7 billion to Taction Technology after a US jury found that its Taptic Engine infringed two haptics patents. The patents relate to haptic technology that produces vibrations in devices such as smartphones and smartwatches. Apple has denied using Taction's technology and said it plans to appeal the verdict. The case dates back to 2021, when Taction accused Apple of using its patented haptic technology without permission.
title: Apple Ordered to Pay $5.7 Billion Over Haptics Patents Used in iPhone, Apple Watch

description: At its Pixel 11 series smartphone launch, Google did not announce a new Pixel Buds Pro model; instead, it announced new features for existing Pixel Buds Pro 2 owners. Google promised that these features would arrive soon as an update to the Pixel Buds app. Google has now seeded some new features in a newly released update for its Pixel Buds app.
title: Google Pixel Buds Pro 2, Pixel Buds 2a Get New Gemini Voice Controls With Latest App Update

description: The Vivo V80 is set to be launched in India soon as the successor to the Vivo V70. In the days leading up to its launch, the brand has revealed several details about the upcoming smartphone, including its design, cameras, display, and battery specifications. Ahead of its anticipated debut, a tipster has leaked the India price and storage configurations of the Vivo V80. It is expected to be introduced at a significantly higher price tag compared to its predecessor.
title: Vivo V80 Price in India, Storage Configurations Tipped Ahead of Launch

description: Lumio Aura 5 has been launched in India as the company's new active bookshelf high-fidelity (Hi-Fi) speakers, the tech firm announced on Tuesday. Moreover, the Lumio Aura 5 is set to go on sale in the country on October 15 via Amazon. The speakers will also be part of the e-commerce giant’s upcoming Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026 sale. The Lumio Aura 5 is the tech firm’s new active bookshelf high-fidelity (Hi-Fi) speakers. The speakers feature DGS Audio Tuning for Studio, Cinema, and Groove audio modes. The Lumio Aura 5 is equipped with a dual 4.5-inch aluminium woofer setup, along with a dual 1-inch silk dome tweeter setup. The Hi-Fi speaker is claimed to deliver a peak audio output of up to 200W and a sustained output of up to 100W.
title: Lumio Aura 5 Launched in India With Dual 4.5-Inch Aluminium Woofers, 200W Peak Output: Price, Specifications

description: There has been a noticeable rise in new smartphone brands entering the Indian market in recent months. What makes it more interesting is that some of these companies are not traditional phone makers at all. For example, wearables brand Boltt recently made the jump to smartphones, and now Mivi is joining the growing list with its first smartphone, Mivi One 5G. The price of the Mivi One 5G in India starts at Rs. 14,999. It packs a 6.75-inch display, Qualcomm's Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 chipset, and a 6,000mAh battery.
title: Mivi One 5G First Impressions

description: Naughty Dog has confirmed that two new projects set in the world of The Last of Us are in early stages of development. The games will expand the canon of The Last of Us beyond Part I and Part II, studio head Neil Druckmann said. Naughty Dog also announced that it would fully reveal Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet in 2027.
title: Naughty Dog Confirms Two New The Last of Us Games, Says Will Fully Reveal Intergalactic in 2027

description: Lava Shark 2 Pro 5G has been launched in India as the third addition to the company's Shark 2 lineup. The smartphone is now on sale in the country via multiple Lava-authorised offline and online retail channels. Moreover, the Lava Shark 2 Pro 5G is offered in Akash Blue and Nanda Silver colour options. The tech firm is also offering free doorstep phone service to customers across India. On top of this, the Lava Shark 2 Pro 5G is powered by an octa-core Unisoc T8200 chipset. Lava claims that the smartphone managed to score more than 5,00,000 points on the AnTuTu benchmarking platform. The smartphone is equipped with a 6.75-inch HD+ (720 x 1,600 pixels) LCD touchscreen, which delivers up to a 120Hz refresh rate.
title: Lava Shark 2 Pro 5G Launched in India With 6,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Apple released the iOS 27.0.1 update for iPhone on Monday. The latest software update comes with key bug fixes for issues that have plagued users since the release of iOS 27 earlier this month. The update is said to address problems affecting the latest iPhone 18 Pro models, including unexpected restarts after failed Face ID authentication and a camera issue that could cause colour artefacts in certain conditions. Apple has also fixed an issue that caused the touchscreen to become unresponsive under certain conditions.
title: Apple Rolls Out iOS 27.0.1 Update With Fixes for iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max Face ID and Camera Issues

description: Nothing Headphone (1) Pro was launched on Tuesday as the company’s latest flagship over-ear offering. The headphones build upon the design language of the original Headphone (1) while adding several new features. They come with a three-driver audio system, improved active noise cancellation (ANC), and a larger battery. Nothing has equipped the Headphone (1) Pro with a bass driver, a precision dynamic driver, and an xMEMS driver for treble. The headphones also support spatial audio with head tracking, LDAC, Bluetooth 6.1, and lossless USB-C audio.
title: Nothing Headphone (1) Pro Launched With Triple Drivers, 46dB ANC and 68-Hour Battery Life: Price, Specifications

description: The iPhone Duo was launched as Apple’s first-ever foldable earlier this month, alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. While the non-fold models have already made their way to customers, the foldable iPhone will go on sale beginning next month. A new leak suggests that the iPhone Duo could offer more software features than the company previewed during its ‘Surprise and shine’ event. It is expected to introduce a new StandBy experience designed specifically around its two-display form factor.
title: iPhone Duo Leak Reveals New StandBy Faces With Smart Home Controls, Apple Watch-Like Customisation
